parents.subject: Less Commonly Taught Languages
parents.course: Advanced Course in a Less Commonly Taught Language II

ns2:section.sectionText: This is the second part of the Bamana superior designed to reinforce further communicative skills in writing, reading and listening. The course is also designed to meet the 5Cs of the National foreign language learning standards i.e. Communication, Cultures, Connections, Comparisons, and Communities. This section is offered through the BTAA Course Share Program hosted by University of Indiana and will be video-conference/Zoom/online taught for participating universities.
